memory.problem: TypeError: Cannot read property 'name' of undefined in UserCard component
memory.solution: Add optional chaining: user?.name. Defensive null guard for missing user prop.

memory.problem: JSON.parse fails on empty string returning SyntaxError
memory.solution: Guard with if (raw.length > 0) before JSON.parse, return null on empty.

memory.problem: React useEffect runs infinitely when state setter is in dep array
memory.solution: Remove setter from deps; setters are stable refs by React contract.

memory.problem: Express middleware order causes auth check to run after route handler
memory.solution: Mount auth middleware before route definitions in app.use order.

memory.problem: TypeError: Cannot read property 'name' of undefined in UserCard component
memory.solution: Add optional chaining: user?.name.

memory.problem: JSON.parse fails on empty string returning SyntaxError
memory.solution: Guard with if (raw.length > 0) before JSON.parse, return null on empty.

memory.problem: React useEffect runs infinitely when state setter is in dep array
memory.solution: Remove setter from deps; setters are stable refs.

cases.query: JSON parse throwing SyntaxError on blank input

memory.problem: useEffect creates infinite render loop because dependency changes every render
memory.solution: Memoize dependency with useMemo, or remove from deps if stable.

memory.problem: useState updater function not invoked, stale closure captures old value
memory.solution: Pass a function to setState: setX(prev => prev + 1).

memory.problem: useCallback returning a new function on every render
memory.solution: Add stable dependencies; primitive deps preferred over objects.

memory.problem: PostgreSQL deadlock between concurrent UPDATE statements on same row
memory.solution: Order locks consistently: SELECT FOR UPDATE in same key order across transactions.

memory.problem: SQLite database is locked error in better-sqlite3 on concurrent writes
memory.solution: Enable WAL mode: PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL.

memory.problem: MongoDB write conflict on findOneAndUpdate with same document
memory.solution: Use upsert with $setOnInsert and retry on duplicate key.

memory.problem: Webpack build fails with Can't resolve 'crypto' in browser bundle
memory.solution: Add fallback in resolve.fallback config: { crypto: false } or polyfill.

memory.problem: Vite import.meta.env undefined in production build
memory.solution: Prefix env vars with VITE_ to expose to client bundle.

memory.problem: TypeScript fails to find module declaration for image import
memory.solution: Add declare module '*.png' to a global.d.ts file.

cases.query: Webpack browser cannot resolve crypto module

memory.problem: Docker container cannot connect to host postgres on localhost:5432
memory.solution: Use host.docker.internal instead of localhost on Mac/Win.

memory.problem: Docker compose service unable to reach another service by name
memory.solution: Both services must be on same default network; use service name as hostname.

memory.problem: Dockerfile COPY fails with file not found despite file existing
memory.solution: Check .dockerignore; build context excludes the file.

cases.query: Docker container can't reach localhost postgres

memory.problem: Promise.all rejects on first error losing partial results
memory.solution: Use Promise.allSettled to collect all outcomes including rejections.

memory.problem: async function inside forEach does not await before loop continues
memory.solution: Use for-of with await, or Promise.all(arr.map(fn)).

memory.problem: unhandled promise rejection crashing Node process
memory.solution: Add .catch() or wrap in try-catch in async function; handle process.on('unhandledRejection').

cases.query: Promise.all losing results when one rejects

memory.problem: CORS preflight failing with Access-Control-Allow-Origin missing
memory.solution: Echo Origin in CORS header, or use cors npm middleware.

memory.problem: Express CORS not setting Access-Control-Allow-Credentials
memory.solution: Set credentials: true in cors options and explicit origin (no wildcard).

memory.problem: Fetch from frontend shows opaque response with no CORS error
memory.solution: Server must return CORS headers; opaque means request was made cross-origin without proper headers.

memory.problem: TypeScript strict mode complains about possibly null in non-null assertion
memory.solution: Use type guard: if (x !== null) instead of x! non-null assertion.

memory.problem: TypeScript Object is possibly undefined on optional chaining result
memory.solution: Use ?? default value or narrow with if check before access.

memory.problem: TypeScript no overload matches this call on overloaded function
memory.solution: Cast argument to specific overload type, or refine input type.

cases.query: TypeScript object is possibly undefined error after optional chaining

memory.problem: git rebase loses commits when branch was already pushed
memory.solution: Force push with lease: git push --force-with-lease to avoid clobbering teammates.

memory.problem: git merge conflict in package-lock.json hard to resolve
memory.solution: Delete lock file, run npm install, commit fresh lock.

memory.problem: git stash pop fails with conflict on same file
memory.solution: Resolve conflict markers manually, then git stash drop.

cases.query: git rebase pushed branch lost commits

memory.problem: Node fetch returns 401 even though token is valid in curl
memory.solution: Strip whitespace and BOM from token; check for trailing newline in env var.

memory.problem: Node fetch returning empty body despite 200 OK
memory.solution: Await response.text() / response.json() — body is a Stream that must be consumed.

memory.problem: Node fetch ECONNRESET on long-running request
memory.solution: Increase keep-alive or implement retry with exponential backoff.

cases.query: fetch returns 401 unauthorized token works in curl

memory.problem: Jest test hangs indefinitely on async operation never resolves
memory.solution: Add jest.setTimeout or mark test async and await all promises explicitly.

memory.problem: Vitest mock not being applied to imported module
memory.solution: Use vi.mock at top-level, before imports — hoisted before transform.

memory.problem: Mocha test passes alone but fails in suite from shared state
memory.solution: Reset state in beforeEach; do not mutate module-level globals.

cases.query: Jest test hangs forever async never resolves

memory.problem: Node Buffer concat throws TypeError on non-Buffer input
memory.solution: Wrap with Buffer.from() or coerce strings before passing to concat.

memory.problem: Stream pipeline silently swallowing errors mid-pipeline
memory.solution: Use stream.pipeline (callback or async) — pipe() does not propagate errors.

memory.problem: fs.readFile vs fs.promises.readFile inconsistent in callbacks
memory.solution: Pick one API; promises version is preferred in modern Node.

cases.query: Node stream pipeline swallowing errors silently
